name: Procgen Action-Conditioned World Model Dataset
summary: 由 Procgen Atari 环境生成的离线帧、动作和终止信号数据，专门用于动作条件下一帧预测与滚动评测。
summaryEn: Offline frames, actions, and termination signals generated from Procgen Atari environments for action-conditioned next-frame prediction and rollout evaluation.
scale: Configurable offline Procgen rollouts with sharded frame/action arrays
scaleZh: 可配置的 Procgen 离线回放，按帧、动作数组分片存储
access: Dataset generation code and rollout evaluation available
accessZh: 数据生成代码和回放评测可用
verdict: 直接用于动作条件视频世界模型训练和误差累积研究
verdictEn: Directly targets action-conditioned video world-model training and compounding-error analysis
wmNote: 离线数据窗口与开放环滚动评测对应世界模型核心工作流。

evidence.sourceTitle: GitHub - Mayavan/world_model: A minimal offline Atari world model for action-conditioned next-frame prediction. Includes dataset generation, training, and rollout evaluation to study compounding error in video prediction under control. · GitHub
evidence.statement: README supplies a CoinRun random-policy dataset-generation command and action-conditioned next-frame/multi-step evaluation. Community generator derived from Procgen.
